documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported its highest-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27 with volumes reaching 1.4 million units and revenue from operations crossing INR 17,244 crores, up 37% YoY. EBITDA margins stood at 20.9%, driven by favourable currency, pricing actions, operating leverage, and disciplined cost control despite elevated raw material inflation. The EV business and exports performed strongly, with electric two-wheelers and three-wheelers now contributing 30% of domestic revenues with double-digit EBITDA percentage. To address demand constraints across EVs, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers, management is expanding total annual capacity from 7 million to 9 million units. Bajaj Auto reported a record financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units and strong export momentum.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to move monthly exports beyond the 250,000 unit level starting in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

guidance.claim: Management targets completing a comprehensive motorcycle portfolio makeover within six weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: The company aims to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment later in the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the near-term domestic motorcycle category growth to be around 7% to 9%.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% YoY in Q1 FY27, led by EV scooters and 150cc to 400cc motorcycles.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance. This growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment of motorcycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail sales in Brazil grew by over 50% during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Retails in Brazil clocked 50%-plus growth with a very healthy financial performance in the subsidiary.

demand_outlook.claim: KTM motorcycle exports from India grew by over 20% YoY, while Triumph brand exports grew by 40% YoY in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: In quarter 1, KTM exports from India grew by 20% plus, while the Triumph brand exports grew by 40% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its total capacity by nearly 25% from 7 million units per annum to 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth. So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand the Chetak exclusive store network from 530-550 stores to 1,000 stores in a couple of years.
capex_expansion.quote: Now that constraint is almost disappearing, which will allow us to now really step on it and expand the network, which is at about, I think, 530 - 550 stores to 1,000 stores. I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin inched up to 20.9% in Q1 FY27, improving by 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation impact reached approximately 4.5% of revenue during Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Chetak turned EBITDA positive during Q1 FY27, helping the combined electric portfolio maintain double-digit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Chetak has now moved from what a few quarters back was EBITDA neutral to now becoming EBITDA positive. So, we now have the contribution of an EBITDA positive on Chetak in addition to the growing scale of the electric three-wheeler that is leading to an overall portfolio margin of double digit.

margins_costs.claim: Management estimates material cost inflation of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the upcoming period.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Three-wheeler exports reached a record 100,000 units in Q1 FY27, registering nearly 70% YoY growth.
orders_capacity.quote: Three-wheeler exports delivered a record of 100,000 units, growing by almost 70%, commanding a dominant market share of over 65% of three-wheeler exports from India, and our growth of secular across regions in mature as well as nascent markets.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak's manufacturing capacity has reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow in Q1 FY27, representing an 80% conversion of PAT.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR 21,000 crores at the end of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company committed INR 10,000 crores in July towards shareholder payouts via dividend and buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Cumulatively, both those corporate actions put together would mean that INR10,000 crores in July would have been paid out to shareholders, right, which essentially will mean that cash will dip from the under INR21,000 crores that existed at the end of June.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year, split between a final dividend and a tender buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material inflation, supply chain disruptions, logistics issues, and a ransomware attack reduced overall product availability by 10% to 15% in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Curtailment of industrial LPG supplies created energy availability challenges early in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Spiralling living costs and workforce migration caused localized manpower shortages that stifled production in April and May.
risks_headwinds.quote: The seasonal effect of this factor aside, the level of labour shortage was exceptionally pronounced this year and particularly stifled production in the months of April and May.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties related to LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics impaired availability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to complete its domestic motorcycle portfolio makeover within six weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets moving monthly exports beyond the 250,000 unit level starting in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand Chetak's exclusive store network to 1,000 stores in a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: Now that constraint is almost disappearing, which will allow us to now really step on it and expand the network, which is at about, I think, 530 - 550 stores to 1,000 stores. I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

management_commitments.claim: New introductions in the Pulsar brand will hit the market starting as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: The buyback payout is expected to happen sometime in the second week of July.
management_commitments.quote: Looking at the fresh timelines, I would expect that payouts would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.
